**About‑Us – Faded Archive**

Faded Archive is a made‑to‑order tee shop headquartered in Manchester. We hand‑pick high‑quality fabrics and print each design after you order, ensuring a fresh, personalised garment every time. Our mission is to fuse contemporary style with sustainable production, giving customers a unique, on‑demand wardrobe that feels as special as the customer who wears it.

**Recommended logo colour**  
Go with a deep charcoal or muted navy—neutral tones that reflect our understated aesthetic and pair well with the bustling Manchester backdrop.
